rule.name: GeneratedMemberCycle
rule.message: The generated toString, equals and hashCode can follow this field around a cycle of fields, so the first log line, HashSet or cache lookup of an object in the cycle recurses until StackOverflowError. Mark the back reference @ToString.Exclude and @EqualsAndHashCode.Exclude, or list the included fields with onlyExplicitlyIncluded = true. A field that only ever points down a tree, never back up, is the intended case.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //ClassDeclaration[@Interface = false()] [ModifierList/Annotation[pmd-java:typeIs('lombok.Data') or pmd-java:typeIs('lombok.Value') or pmd-java:typeIs('lombok.ToString') or pmd-java:typeIs('lombok.EqualsAndHashCode')]] /ClassBody/FieldDeclaration[not(pmd-java:modifiers() = 'static')][not(PrimitiveType)] [not(ClassType[pmd-java:typeIsExactly('java.lang.String')])] /VariableDeclarator/VariableId
